# Computer Custom

Queue Windows desktop actions with a countdown and shared pause controls.

| Maintenance | Maintained |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.3.1 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code |
| License | MIT |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/computer-custom) |

Personally used and maintained as needed, without a release schedule or support guarantee.

## Example request

> Use Computer Custom to prepare a desktop batch with a visible countdown.

## Requirements

Windows only. The optional signed UIAccess helper has additional setup requirements.

- Windows
- Node.js and Git
- Optional: the signed UIAccess helper for elevated application windows

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add computer-custom@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install computer-custom@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Start a new session and explicitly select Computer Custom for prepared batches, shared Snooze, UIAccess, or saved local flows.
- Use the bundled Computer tools for ordinary desktop tasks. See the source README for UIAccess setup and input behavior.
